anchors_verified.AAE_corroboration: Forestieri et al. 2018 nascent-soot AAE 1.38 +/- 0.36 (ACP 18:12141) - C&C shape is compatible with measured nascent-soot spectral slope
anchors_verified.cool_carbon_MAC_633_corroboration: 6.647 vs independently derived 6.517 (B&B 7.5*(550/633)): +2.0%. Treated as CORROBORATION, not tuned against. Makes the phi(T) hot<->cool transition near-continuous in absorption.

carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier. Final adoption per FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS8 requires re-encoding as RISE-CBOR64-v1; adopted record ID is SHA-256 of those exact bytes. Density and table are ONE payload by construction so a later density change cannot silently change radiance.

definition.E_CC_source: Chang & Charalampopoulos 1990 dispersion (see fire_optics_em_soot_cc1990.draft.json for formulas/provenance)

normalization_target.primary: Liu, Yon, Fuentes, Lobo, Smallwood, Corbin 2020, Aerosol Sci. Tech. 54:33-51: 8.0 +/- 0.7 from ten direct measurements (full text verified by owner via NRC-Canada repository)

pinned_density_g_cm3.applicability: conversion density for E_eff = MAC*rho*lambda/(6*pi); hashed with the table so a density change changes the record ID

uncertainty.note: the RECORD pins 1.8 exactly for the MAC<->E_eff conversion (identity-bearing); the range is the measurement spread behind the pin

derived_quantity: E_eff(lambda) = MAC(lambda)*rho_soot*lambda/(6*pi), with the pinned density below
design_note_corrections: Simulator coupling correction (owner, 2026-08-05, verified against SS3.5 text): in the burning beta-branch, q_rad = beta*e with beta = chi_r*Qdot_tot/Sum(e*V), so total radiative loss is pinned at chi_r*Qdot and a uniform opacity rescale cancels through beta. E affects spatial allocation of cooling, constituent shares, beta<=1 admissibility/optical thickness, the implicit local T update, and the post-fire gamma branch - NOT the global burning-branch loss.

Forestieri scope: the 9.1/7.1 m2/g plateau describes larger mature soot (>~160nm); maturity dependence is explicit in that paper. It anchors the mass-to-absorption normalization, not young-soot optics per se.
out_of_domain_policy: NO preview extrapolation rule is named for this record. The tabulated certified domain is [380, 780] nm, matching the renderer's NM band exactly; per SS8, out-of-domain lookups REJECT in both predictive and preview modes. The long-wave (>780nm) extension for SS3.5 Planck means is NOT carried by this table: it is a separate future record axis (C&C dispersion to 30um with the explicit long-wave model-form uncertainty per the 2026-08-05 freeze), and consuming this record outside [380, 780] nm is an error, never an extrapolation.
quantity_semantics: NOT an unqualified refractive-index-derived E(m). Population-averaged hot-carbon effective absorption closure: incorporates everything needed to reproduce measured absorption per transported soot mass through the renderer's simple Rayleigh expression sigma_a = 6*pi*E_eff*f_v/lambda, which applies no separate aggregate-interaction correction. Not a universal soot material constant; not a soot-maturity model. Liu et al.'s E>0.32 lower bound is NOT the runtime central value for exactly this reason (it assumes optical-model corrections RISE does not apply).

table_metadata.applicability: population-averaged hot-carbon effective absorption closure; see quantity_semantics
table_metadata.provenance: definition block of this record (C&C dispersion x MAC(550)=8.0 normalization)

uncertainty.components: see record-level uncertainty_components: visible normalization +/-16% (assumption_bound over the B&B ensemble), C&C shape ~5-6% (measured fit-vs-KK), long-wave model-form (assumption_bound, unquantified magnitude carried as the explicit statement)

uncertainty_components.cc_spectral_shape_fit: C&C primary (read 2026-08-05): fit agrees with KK-inferred indices on average ~5% in n, ~6% in k over 0.4-30um
uncertainty_components.long_wave_extension: LARGER EXPLICIT MODEL-FORM UNCERTAINTY: >6.4um is C&C's KK-constrained fit intent, not an independently measured absolute spectrum; the normalization transfer to IR assumes lambda-independent magnitude correction (unverifiable)
uncertainty_components.visible_normalization: +/-16% (conservative; covers the Bond-Bergstrom ensemble; Liu's own is +/-0.7/8.0 = 8.8%)

validation_gates: G1: MAC(550) = 8.0 m2/g exact by construction; MAC(632.8) = 6.647 m2/g derived - both asserted numerically at record load
G2: C&C visible shape anchors: E_eff(380)/E_eff(780) = 1.311; visible AAE(380-780) = 1.377 (Forestieri-compatible)
G3: independent numerical Planck means kappa_P(T) and their derivatives over the complete certified temperature range (SS3.5), cross-implemented

G4: sim-side: beta<=1 feasibility, spatial cooling redistribution, and post-fire (gamma-branch) sensitivity across the uncertainty envelope - NOTE the burning-branch global loss is pinned to chi_r*Qdot by beta, so uniform magnitude error cancels there; the gates target what does NOT cancel
G5: the eventual SS12-item-4 absolute flame-radiance dataset is VALIDATION, selected independently - never a hidden one-point refit
